The after-row for the overlay warm, on the same device and the same ASTC pak (`20:18 12-08-2026`, `build/phone`). App rebuilt with `warmOverlaySurface` + the drawing `warmTextMetrics` + the resize guard (616f1f2).

**`overlay:clear` on the first frame: 212.1 ms → 0.1 ms.** The window mean moves with it, 0.566 → 0.000113 ms, which is the same statement said twice: the cost was one allocation and it now happens at boot, overlapped with the wait for the pak, instead of on the first drawn frame. Worst frame overall **333.1 → 123.0 ms**, and `dtMax` **390.5 → 140.1**.

| first-frame segment | before (08-25 split) | after | |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `overlay:clear` | 212.1 ms | **0.1 ms** | the allocation, warmed at boot |
| `engine-frame` | 77.9 ms | 77.9 ms | unchanged, and now the largest item |
| `overlay:symbols` | 22.6 ms | 20.3 ms | **the glyph warm barely moved it** |
| worst frame | 333.1 ms | **123.0 ms** | |

**Two things this row does NOT claim.** The `fillText('0')` added to `warmTextMetrics` was supposed to warm the glyph atlas and it bought 2.3 ms of 22.6 — so whatever `symbology.render` pays for on its first pass, drawing one digit off-canvas is not it. Left in (it is free and it is not wrong) but not counted as a fix. And **`engine-frame` at 77.9 ms is identical in both captures**, to the tenth: that is a fixed first-frame cost of the engine's own pass, untouched by any of this, and it is what the next round would go after.

**The frame-rate numbers here are NOT a before/after and must not be read as one.** This run is a different workload: `projection: ortho` at height 267 (the operator toggled PLAN and pulled back), 42 cells created against 14, a 46.9 s window against 24.2. `fps 21 → 30`, `dtP50 47.9 → 33.2` and `dtMean 60.5 → 45.8` belong to that, not to a one-shot 212 ms removed from a 47-second window. What IS attributable is the span that was measured directly.

Everything else holds. Resident **76.4 MB**, content **38.6 MB for 4 cells** — the fourth capture running. Streaming quiet at four times the cell churn: 42 creates, 0 evictions, **0 late**, worst blob 4.5 ms, worst create 20.9. Idle-dominated as always (638 of 1 525 frames skipped; the 65-frame spike at 100 ms is the gate). And **`chipsDropped: 0` with 12 chips** — pulled back in plan view the declutter fits every label, against 5 of 10 dropped at street height in the row before, which is 3/03's rule doing exactly what it says.

Conditions: MGA-LX3 / ARM Bifrost, 360x377 CSS @ DPR 2, ASTC + ETC2, no BC, no `timestamp-query`. District `los-santos-centre`. Pasted into chat rather than filed through the panel.
